reference_policy.no_visual_reference_rule: before production media generation present at least three materially distinct numbered artistic-rendering routes in chat; each route must include a name, story interpretation, rendering/media treatment, and numbered mini-storyboard of at least three beats/frames; record all routes plus the current user's explicit selection/hybrid/modification in MEDIA_PLAN.json and lock the selection
reference_policy.no_visual_reference_decision_artifacts_r: concept/storyboard previews made solely for route selection are allowed before lock but are not production assets unless the selected direction explicitly adopts them

music_story_policy.lyrics_present_rule: preserve verified lyrics in LYRICS.md; present lyrics are directing authority by default unless the current user explicitly excludes them
music_story_policy.lyrics_exclusion_rule: if the current user explicitly excludes present lyrics from directing, keep lyrics.status=present, record directing_use=excluded_by_current_user plus the current user instruction, omit lyrics from SCRIPT.basis and lyric_cue fields, and use music analysis as primary directing authority
music_story_policy.no_lyrics_rule: music analysis becomes the primary narrative authority; absence of lyrics never permits skipping story construction
music_story_policy.genre_rule: if genre/song type cannot be identified confidently, ask the current user before approach/story lock and record the user's declaration as authoritative
music_story_policy.script_rule: after storyboard lock and before shot packages, create SCRIPT.md and machine-readable SCRIPT.json covering the complete target frame range; every script entry must map story action, visual media, animation behavior, music cues, lyric cue when applicable, and transition
music_story_policy.preview_rule: a request to keep chat light or suppress previews must never be interpreted as permission to replace required production imagery with procedural placeholders; if the generation runtime surfaces image previews, those previews are allowed as part of producing real media
